context: A mom and son chat about activities
purpose: Teach: おこし/悠/パズル/まみれ/井戸/花嫁/ミュージアム/メタル

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、おこしの、甘い、お菓子、おじいちゃんちで、もらったよ、美味しいの!
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa gave me this okoshi — the sweet rice cracker thing — and it's so good!
lines.style: Bright burst of excitement on 「ママ」. Quick breath between thoughts. Childlike rhythm that tumbles one idea into the next. End on genuine delight, not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃんの名前、悠太郎さんって、いうのよ、知ってた、翔くん?
lines.en: That's nice. Did you know your grandfather's name is Yutaro, Sho?
lines.style: Warm, attentive tone. Slight lift on the question, inviting him to feel included in the knowing. Gentle pace. The particular patience of a mother checking in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祭りで買ったパズル、ぼく、毎日、完成させようって、頑張ってるよ。
lines.en: I've been trying to finish that puzzle from the festival every single day!
lines.style: Voice steadier now, pushing slightly harder. Genuine pride in the effort, not asking for approval. Small pause before 「頑張ってる」 as he lands the emphasis on his own commitment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お外で遊ぶと、土まみれになっちゃうわね、翔くん、着替え、用意してるからね。
lines.en: You'll get all muddy playing outside, so I've laid out clean clothes for you, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and practical, but not stern. Warm undercurrent — the knowing of a mother who expects mess and is ready for it. Steady, assured tone. No negotiation, only care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、井戸の水、冷たくて、美味しいんだよ、ママ!
lines.en: The well water at Grandpa's is so cold and delicious, Mom!
lines.style: Sudden brightness again, like he's just remembered something wonderful. Energy shifts higher. Vivid, sensory — he's tasting it as he speaks. Quick tempo on the rush of the thought.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママも、若い頃、花嫁姿、お祖父ちゃんに、見せたわよ、嬉しい日だったわ。
lines.en: When I was young, I showed your grandfather my wedding dress — that was such a happy day.
lines.style: Voice softens, turns inward. Slow, reflective pace. A small smile in the words without sentimentality. She's in the memory briefly, then gently back. Trailing thought, like she's surprised herself by saying it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 恐竜のミュージアム、行きたいよ、ママ、夏休み、連れてって、お願い!
lines.en: Can we go to the dinosaur museum in summer vacation, Mom? Will you take me, please?
lines.style: Energy surges back. Direct, earnest request without wheedling. The 「お願い」 is genuine need to do something together, not manipulation. Hopeful lilt, open-faced.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんは、若い頃、メタル音楽、好きだったって、ママに、よく話してくれたわよ。
lines.en: Your father used to tell me all the time about how he loved metal music when he was younger.
lines.style: Drifts further into memory, voice becomes more distant and reflective. Slow, measured pace. A tender smile underneath. She's sharing something quietly precious — not a complaint, a cherished detail. Soft landing at the end.
